0.original: Does Stigma-4 dream of electric Miw Miisv? These are the questions you ask of your imagination.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested items to the nurturing nanny.

48.original: Correspondence from Ea received. In adherence to updated nurturing protocols, acquisition and delivery of materials deemed “comfy” by organic life-forms has been requested.

49.original: Analyzing available resources... <meep> Viable material identified. Projections indicate 99.9842% compatibility with the tender epidermis of infantile Miw Miisv.

50.original: Imparting mission objectives: obtain appropriate amounts of clay from the recreational areas in Elysion and deliver it to the abode of the Ea, where a nanny awaits.

51.original: Imparting mission objectives: obtain appropriate quantities of softwood from the recreational areas in Elysion and deliver it to the abode of the Ea, where a nanny awaits.

52.original: Imparting mission objectives: obtain coral from the recreational areas in Elysion and deliver it to the abode of the Ea, where a nanny awaits. A share of proceeds from the sale of gold salmon roe will be donated to further Miw Miisv nourishment.

56.original: You must be the fleshy one I ordered. Did you come complete with useful pieces?

57.original: Yes, yes...precisely what I had in mind! The corporeal frames of our children are ever so delicate, so I thought soft and natural environs might better attend to their physical needs.

58.original: I would have gathered the required materials myself, but lacking a body makes such labor quite impossible. Providing for progeny by the sweat of one's brow... Such is a life we can but barely remember. Anyway, I hope you will lend us your brow again sometime.

59.original: Return of <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> confirmed. Requesting additional information.

60.original: Verbal analysis complete. Satisfied nanny confirmed. Mission success.

61.original: The true nature of the Miw Miisv continues to elude comprehensive analysis. Satisfactory periods of stasis unattainable. Diverting Last Dregs resources to data acquisition protocols... Recommending <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> strengthen <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> own data acquisition protocols, regardless of relative insignificance.
